title: Meal Planning for Osteoporosis
subtitle: Evidence-based meal planning considerations related to meal planning for osteoporosis.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports calcium and vitamin D intake for bone health and fracture reduction. Moderate evidence exists for roles of protein and other micronutrients. Emerging research continues on dietary patterns and supplemental strategies. Safety data urge cautious supplementation use.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
